attchmntText: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited submitted the Copy of Newspaper Publication published in Business Standard and Navshakti on November 07, 2026, confirming the dispatch of Postal Ballot Notice through electronic mode.
voiceSummary: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited submitted newspaper advertisements confirming the dispatch of a Postal Ballot Notice on November 07, 2026. The notice relates to the re-appointment of directors and the appointment of auditors. The company placed these matters before members for approval via postal ballot. The announcement does not state that the resolutions have been passed. Results are pending. The notice was published in Business Standard and Navshakti. The filing was made by Aniket Hirpara, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The document includes details regarding the re-appointment of directors and the appointment of auditors for the financial year ending March 2027. The specific names and DINs of the directors are listed in the attached documents. The auditors proposed for appointment are listed with their registration numbers. The postal ballot process is ongoing. Shareholders are requested to cast their votes. The results of the postal ballot will be announced after the scrutiny of votes. The company has complied with SEBI Listing Regulations. The notice period for the postal ballot is specified. The electronic mode of dispatch was used. The advertisements confirm the dispatch date. The submission is for the record of BSE and NSE. The scrip code is 543277. The trading symbol is LXCHEM.

attchmntText: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited has submitted copy of newspaper publication of the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Laxmi Organic Industries Limited submitted newspaper advertisements regarding its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a total income of 59,886.70 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 54,464.06 million rupees for the same period in 2025. The profit after tax was 31.38 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, versus a loss of 92.85 million rupees in the corresponding previous period. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income was 1,14,350.77 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 724.12 million rupees. Diluted earnings per share were 29.74 rupees for the quarter and 721.94 rupees for the half year. The results are available on the National Stock Exchange website at www.nseindia.com and the Bombay Stock Exchange website at www.bseindia.com.
